evidence.quote: Inflation continues to be too high, and I expect it will likely be appropriate for the Committee to raise rates further and hold them at a restrictive level for some time
I see a continued risk that high energy prices could reverse some of the progress we have seen on inflation in recent months.
Real gross domestic product (GDP) has been growing at a solid pace. Consumer spending has remained robust, and the housing sector appears to be continuing to rebound.
monetary policy may have smaller effects on bank lending and the economy than in the past.
suggests that further policy tightening will be needed to bring inflation down in a sustainable and timely manner.
